name: strip_and_autotag
title: Strip and AutoTag
desc: Clears existing document structure and re-tags from scratch using AutoTag. Suitable for documents whose tag tree is too malformed to repair incrementally.

actions.name: clear_structure
actions.title: Clear Document Structure
actions.desc: Remove all existing tags, structure tree, and bookmarks to allow a clean re-tagging pass.

actions.name: flatten_xobject
actions.title: Flatten Form XObjects
actions.desc: Inline Form XObjects into page content so AutoTag can process all content elements directly.

actions.name: embed_font
actions.title: Embed Fonts
actions.desc: Embed all fonts used in the document to ensure consistent rendering and reliable text extraction.

actions.name: add_missing_unicode
actions.title: Add Missing Unicode Mappings
actions.desc: Add missing Unicode mappings to text elements to ensure correct text extraction and screen reader output.

actions.name: add_tags
actions.title: AutoTag (Full, Overwrite)
actions.desc: Automatically tag the entire document from scratch. Overwrite is enabled because the structure was cleared; preflight and standard attributes are disabled for a conservative pass.

actions.name: set_language
actions.title: Set Document Language (en-US)
actions.desc: Define the primary document language to ensure correct pronunciation and processing by assistive technologies.

actions.name: set_title
actions.title: Set Title (From File Name)
actions.desc: Set the document Title metadata from the input file name as a deterministic fallback.

actions.name: set_display_doc_title
actions.title: Fix Display Document Title
actions.desc: Synchronize the ViewerPreferences DisplayDocTitle setting with the actual document title.

actions.name: set_pdf_ua_standard
actions.title: Set PDF/UA-1 Identifier
actions.desc: Declare PDF/UA-1 conformance by setting the appropriate PDF/UA identifier in the document metadata.

actions.name: set_suspect_value
actions.title: Clear Suspect Flag
actions.desc: Fix the MarkInfo dictionary by clearing the Suspects entry, indicating the document structure is no longer considered unreliable.

actions.name: fix_oc_name
actions.title: Fix Optional Content Configuration
actions.desc: Repair Optional Content (OCG) configuration dictionaries to ensure layer definitions are valid and accessible.

actions.name: fix_media_clip_keys
actions.title: Fix Media Clip (Content-Type to text/plain)
actions.desc: Fix media clip content type keys to a safe default to prevent validation failures on embedded media metadata.

actions.name: set_annot_contents
actions.title: Set Annotation Contents (BBox text, Link/Highlight/Markup)
actions.desc: Populate Contents for Link, Highlight, Underline, Squiggly, and StrikeOut annotations using text extracted from the annotation bounding box.

actions.name: set_annot_contents
actions.title: Set Annotation Contents (Auto-generated fallback, All)
actions.desc: Populate annotation Contents for all annotation types using auto-generated text as a fallback when no meaningful source text is available.

actions.name: create_bookmarks
actions.title: Create Bookmarks (H1–H6)
actions.desc: Generate a bookmark outline from heading tags H1 through H6 to support document navigation.
